decks.name: Embers
decks.blurb: Questions, confessions, touch, play, and dares. Everything you need for a first night, or a hundredth.

decks.name: Wildfire
decks.blurb: Big, one-time, story-you'll-tell-later challenges. Role reversals, classes, hotel nights, naked Twister.

decks.name: Slow Burn

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: How to play
rules.html:
How to play

Set your heat. Everyone picks a max heat, 1 to 5. The table plays at the lowest number picked. No one has to say why.

Take turns. Draw, read it out loud, then choose: do it now, claim it for later, or skip it. Skipping is always free.

Score Sparks. The number in the corner is what the card is worth. First to the goal catches fire.

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Sparks & the Woodpile
rules.html:
Sparks

Quick night: first to 25. Long night: 50. Season: keep a running total for a month.

The Woodpile. Big cards (Wildfire, Slow Burn) are usually claimed now and done later. Keep them face up in front of you. They score when you complete them.

Match cards. Everyone votes in secret. If everyone says yes, everyone does it and everyone scores double.

Wild cards bend the rules. Follow what they say.

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Consent & care
rules.html:
Consent & care

Every card is optional. Skip any card, any time, no reason given, no penalty, no eyebrows.

“Cool it.” Anyone can say it. The heat cap drops by one for the rest of the game.

“Ember out.” Anyone can say it. The game ends right there and you go get water, snacks, and a hug.

A yes tonight is not a yes forever. Check in like it's part of the game, because it is.

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: The Pot
rules.html:
The Pot

Optional, and fun. Before a Season starts, everyone puts the same amount into a jar. $20, $100, whatever feels right.

At the end, the player with the most Sparks picks how the whole pot gets spent, from a wish list you all wrote together: a hotel night, a class, a dinner you've been eyeing.

The catch: the player with the fewest Sparks has to plan it. Everyone goes. Everybody wins, someone just wins a little more.

cards.label: Play
cards.text: Make up a 30-second song about how you met. A key change is mandatory.

cards.text: Give a dramatic sports-commentator recap of the first time you two hung out. Slow-motion replays encouraged.

cards.text: Everyone stands. On three, strike your most heroic album-cover pose and hold it for ten seconds.

cards.label: Play
cards.text: Describe your partner like a rare creature in a nature documentary. Hushed narrator voice required.

cards.label: Play
cards.text: Do your best impression of them flirting. They get a rebuttal impression of you.

cards.label: Play

cards.label: Play
cards.text: Pitch your partner as a dating profile in three sentences. Include one red flag and one green flag.

cards.label: Play

cards.text: Hot or Cold: hide an imaginary kiss somewhere on your body. They hunt for it with their lips while you call hotter or colder.

cards.text: Guide their hand to exactly where and how you like to be touched. Narrate. They're taking notes.

cards.label: Dare
cards.text: Point to a spot below your waistband. They kiss it for a slow count of ten, over clothes or under. Your call.

cards.text: Strip down to what you'd be brave enough to answer the door in. Stay that way for three turns.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Pass It On: keep this. When you draw a card you'd rather give away, hand it to anyone you like. They play it as if they drew it.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Double Down: the next card anyone plays is worth double Sparks. Make it count.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Cool It: everyone's heat cap drops by one for the next 3 turns. Breathe. Hydrate. Smolder.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Turn It Up: if everyone agrees, the heat cap rises by one for the next 3 turns. One no keeps it where it is.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Steal the Woodpile: take any claimed card from someone else's Woodpile and do it yourself. The Sparks are yours now.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Reverse: the person to your right reads your next card and does it to you. Sit back and receive.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Free Pass: keep this. Play it any time to skip a card and still score 1 Spark. No explanation needed.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Callback: pick any card played tonight and do it again. Full Sparks, encore energy.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Your Rules: invent a card on the spot and play it. The person receiving it chooses the heat.

cards.label: Wild card
cards.text: Truce: everyone gains 3 Sparks and takes a water break. Snacks count too.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Learn a dance from a music video, every step, and perform it for each other. Costumes strongly encouraged.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Spend a whole day letting a coin flip choose every turn, every meal, every stop. Go wherever it sends you.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Take a class neither of you would ever pick: fencing, trapeze, glassblowing. Whoever's worse buys dinner.

cards.text: Write each other letters, seal them, and hide them somewhere safe. Open them together in five years.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Leave them a love note every day for a week, each hidden somewhere stranger than the last.

cards.label: Challenge

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Secret vote: if everyone says yes, go skinny-dipping somewhere secluded under the stars. Nobody around, nothing on.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Cook a three-course dinner wearing nothing but aprons. Anything that burns, you start over. Maybe.

cards.text: Handwrite them a real love letter, three pages minimum, and read it aloud to them in the bath.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Sit in the back row of a late movie and make out like it's your first date. Leave before the credits.

cards.text: Spend a whole evening touching only hands, faces, and hair. Nothing else, no matter how tempting it gets.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Kiss at the top of something tall: a rooftop, a mountain, a ferris wheel. Hold it until your knees go weak.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Book a hotel in your own city. Arrive separately, meet at the bar as strangers, and let them pick you up.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Secret vote: if everyone says yes, hold a 24-hour yes day. Agree on limits first, then every ask gets a yes.

cards.label: Challenge

cards.text: Cook a candlelit dinner at home, dress up properly, and remove one piece of clothing per course.

cards.text: Text them every hour for a whole day, each message hotter than the last, until they walk through the door.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Reenact the sexiest scene from a film you both love, dialogue included, until you can't keep a straight face.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Visit a sensual shop together. Each secretly buys one gift for the other. Unwrap them that night.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Write out a detailed fantasy, seal it, and hand it over. They have one month to make it real.

cards.text: Go to a fancy dinner with nothing on under your clothes. Only you two know. Act completely normal.

cards.text: Have sex somewhere semi-public you can actually get away with. Discreet, private, nobody sees. Plan the escape route.

cards.text: Tease each other for a full week: kisses, touches, whispered promises. No sex until Sunday night.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Secret vote: if everyone says yes, try the thing that's been on your wish list the longest. Limits first, then go.

cards.text: Have sex in every room of your home in one weekend. Yes, the laundry room counts.

cards.text: Write each other a filthy short story starring the two of you. Swap and read them aloud in bed.

cards.text: Spend a whole night with no hands allowed, only mouths. Whoever uses hands first makes breakfast.

cards.text: Write a menu of ten things you want them to do to you. They order one each night for ten nights.

cards.text: Try a new position every night for a week. Keep a secret scorecard. Crown a winner on day seven.

cards.label: Challenge
cards.text: Prop a mirror beside the bed, leave the lights on, and keep your eyes open the whole time.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap chores for a week. All of them, including the gross one nobody ever talks about.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap who drives, who navigates, and who controls the music for a week. Zero backseat commentary allowed.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap date-planning for a month. Whoever usually plans sits back; whoever usually follows plans everything.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap morning routines for a week: their alarm, their breakfast, their coffee order, their playlist.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap who says 'I love you' first for a week. The usual first-sayer is only allowed to say it back.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap wardrobes for a day: each picks the other's full outfit, underwear included, and they wear it out.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap who initiates for a week. Whoever usually reaches first has to wait. Whoever usually waits makes every move.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap who's in charge in the bedroom for one night. Agree on limits, then the usual leader follows every instruction.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Swap who seduces whom: the one usually pursued sets the scene, the music, the outfit, and the opening line.

cards.label: Reversal
cards.text: Spend one night doing to them exactly what they usually do to you, move for move. They'll get the message.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Rehearse a song in secret as a group, then ambush one player with a full serenade. Harmonies optional, choreography mandatory.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Recreate a famous album cover as a group photo shoot. Costumes, props, the exact pose. Frame the winner.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Host a progressive dinner: one course at each player's place. Every host picks the theme and the dress code.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Throw a roast-and-toast night: draw a name, prepare two minutes of roast and two minutes of toast, then deliver both.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Secret vote: if everyone says yes, do a sunrise cold-water plunge together, then a huge breakfast to recover.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Everyone writes one thing they've never told this group, anonymously. Shuffle, read them aloud over dessert, then guess.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Read aloud to them while they're in the bath. Their pick of book, your best voice for every character.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Brush their hair for ten slow minutes. No talking unless they start it.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Paint each other's nails. You each pick the other's color, and nobody gets a veto.

cards.label: Ritual

cards.label: Ritual

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Wash their hair at the sink like a fancy salon: warm water, slow scalp massage, towel turban to finish.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Teach each other a skill you're secretly proud of: a card trick, a recipe, a song. Twenty minutes each.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Give them a hand massage while they tell you about their day, start to finish, no interruptions.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Make a playlist where every song is tied to one specific night together. Play it start to finish, lights low.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Everyone drops their phone in a bowl by the door for the whole evening. First to reach for theirs does the dishes.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Run their morning for them: coffee made, clothes laid out, towel warmed, sent off with a kiss.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Bathe them and wash their hair. No phones in the room, no rushing, and they don't lift a finger.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Give them a full-body massage with no expectation of anything after. And mean it.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Lie face to face and find every scar, freckle, and mark on their skin. Ask for the story behind each one.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Spend a whole morning in bed: no alarms, no screens, just talking, dozing, and whatever else wanders in.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Start a Sunday-night ritual in bed: one thing you loved about them this week, one thing you need, one thing you want to try.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Do their skincare for them, slowly and carefully, like it's the most important job you'll have all week.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Rub lotion into every inch of them after their shower. Every inch they offer, anyway.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Sleep naked tonight, skin to skin, with nothing expected. Just notice everything.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Every night this week, end the day with a wordless kiss that lasts a full minute. On the last night, don't stop at a minute.

cards.label: Ritual
cards.text: Start a standing weekly night that belongs only to sex: same candle, same playlist, calendar blocked. Tonight is the first one.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Sunrise picnic. Pack it the night before and bring a blanket big enough for everyone to hide under.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Museum date: each of you finds the piece that reminds you of the other. Big reveal over coffee after.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Thrift-store challenge: draw names, then $20 each to dress your person head to toe. Runway walk at the end.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Farmers market date: $15 each to build the best picnic you can. Then judge each other's haul.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Stargazing night: drive somewhere dark, lie back on a blanket, and name a constellation after each other.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Potluck where everyone brings the dish their family made when someone was sick. Tell the story before you serve.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Bookstore date: buy each other a book with a hidden note inside. No peeking until you're home.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Cook a dish from the country you most want to visit together. Set the table like you've already landed.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Slow dance in the kitchen to a song from the year you met. Burnt dinner is acceptable.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Plan a date for them using only clues. Send one riddle an hour until they work out where to show up.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Go back to the spot of your first date or first kiss. Order the same thing. Compare memories; whoever's wrong pays.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Game night: everyone teaches the group a game from their childhood. Winner picks the snacks for the next one.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Each of you secretly writes your pick: sunrise hike, fancy dinner, or a full day in pajamas. If you match, book it this week.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Rainy-day date: build a blanket fort and double-feature a movie from the year each of you was born.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Weekend away with no itinerary. Pick a direction, drive two hours, and say yes to whatever you find.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Secretly write your pick: a hotel night in your own city, a cabin with no signal, or one of you plans everything blind. Match? Book it.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Dinner where you can only ask each other questions you've never asked before. Repeat one and you're paying.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Go dancing somewhere loud, then walk home somewhere quiet. Hold hands the whole way.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Get dressed up for a date at home: separate rooms, a knock at the door, proper first-date nerves.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Give them a tour of you: the places that shaped you before you met. End at the one that matters most.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Recreate the night you first slept together, or the one you wish had happened. Same playlist, better lighting.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Late-night drive, no destination. Park somewhere with a view and climb into the back seat like you've got a curfew.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Each secretly circle one: a night of slow massages, a night trying something new, or a night one of you is in charge. Match? It's on this week.

cards.label: Date
cards.text: Plan a whole-weekend date where every single stop is foreplay for the last one: the bedroom.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Blindfold them and feed them five tastes, one at a time. Every wrong guess earns a kiss.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: An evening where nobody is allowed to rush: every kiss, touch, and sentence at half speed.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Kiss only their hands, wrists, and forearms for five slow minutes. Nowhere else, no matter how nicely they ask.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Share a candlelit bath. One rule: nobody mentions work, chores, or tomorrow.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Candlelit massage with warm oil. They choose where you start; you choose how long you stay.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Undress each other as slowly as possible: one minute per item, timer on, no skipping ahead.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Shower together where only one of you is allowed to do the washing. Switch tomorrow.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Trace an ice cube wherever they point. Then follow the trail with your mouth.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Map every spot that makes them shiver using only your fingertips. Report your findings out loud.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Loosely tie their wrists with a silk scarf and take your time everywhere. Untie the second they ask.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Spend an entire evening on foreplay. Set a one-hour timer before anyone's allowed to go further.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Have sex by candlelight with your eyes open the whole time. Say their name whenever you want to look away.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Blindfold yourself and let them guide your hands wherever they want to be touched, as slowly as they like.

cards.label: Sensual
cards.text: Ask tonight, then tomorrow wake them up slowly, kissing your way down one inch at a time.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Everyone's yes/no list is read aloud, one item at a time. No reactions allowed except a nod of thanks.
cards.aftercare: Go around once more: everyone names one thing they're glad someone else shared.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Compliment circle: start sweet, and every round gets bolder. Anyone can say 'pass' or 'hold here' at any time.
cards.aftercare: Group hug, then everyone tells the person on their left one thing they'll remember.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: The group chooses one person to be the center of attention for five minutes. They say what's on the table; everyone else delivers.
cards.aftercare: Whoever was the center picks who holds them afterward.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Before anything starts, everyone says out loud: watching, playing, or undecided. Undecided is a perfectly good answer.
cards.aftercare: Everyone shares one thing they loved seeing or doing tonight.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: One person directs a scene for the others: where to sit, who kisses whom, how slow. Actors check in at every cue.
cards.aftercare: The director thanks each actor by name and asks what they'd change next time.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Pass a blindfold around. Whoever wears it is kissed by someone after a silent thumbs-up. They guess who.
cards.aftercare: Lift the blindfold and let them hug whoever they guessed wrong.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Pick a slow scene together. Every three minutes, pause: everyone says green, yellow, or red. Any red changes the plan, no reasons needed.
cards.aftercare: Close with everyone naming the moment they felt most cared for.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Everyone secretly signals: is everybody undressing together tonight? It only happens if everyone says yes.
cards.aftercare: Pile under one big blanket and let each person say how they're feeling.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Two of you tease each other while one watches and directs. Rotate until everyone has had the director's chair.
cards.aftercare: Regroup and let each director say what they enjoyed seeing most.

cards.label: Group
cards.text: Everyone writes their wildest group fantasy anonymously. Shuffle, read aloud, vote on one to try. A single 'no' vetoes it.
cards.aftercare: Seal the unchosen cards in an envelope for another night.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Each of you writes three columns: yes, no, maybe. Swap lists. Ask about the one maybe that made you lean in.
cards.aftercare: Thank them for one answer that took courage, and mean it.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Name one hard limit and one curious maybe. The limit needs no explanation. The maybe gets all the questions.
cards.aftercare: Hold hands and repeat their hard limit back so they know you heard it.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Choose a safeword together. Bonus if it makes you both laugh. Then practice saying it once, completely seriously.
cards.aftercare: Seal the safeword with a slow kiss and a promise to always honor it.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Describe a fantasy in vivid detail. Your partner listens without touching you. Not even a little.
cards.aftercare: Let them close the gap: one long hug, no words needed.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: What would make you feel completely safe trying something new? Answer in detail while your partner takes notes.
cards.aftercare: Read their notes back to them and ask if you got it right.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Rate these 1 to 5 out loud: being told what to do, being blindfolded, being praised, being teased. Compare scores.
cards.aftercare: Tell them which of their answers you'll be thinking about tomorrow.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Agree on traffic lights: green means more, yellow means slow down, red means stop. Then whisper 'green' and see what happens.
cards.aftercare: Check in after: what color are you now, and what do you need?

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Confess one thing you've wanted to try but were too shy to ask for. Your partner may only reply 'tell me more.'
cards.aftercare: Kiss their forehead and tell them nothing they said could make you think less of them.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Negotiate a scene like a contract: who leads, how long, what's on the table, what's off. Sign it with a kiss.
cards.aftercare: Review the 'contract' afterward and agree on one clause to change next time.

cards.label: Negotiate
cards.text: Answer by pointing: where do you love being touched, where is off-limits tonight, and where are you curious?
cards.aftercare: Wrap them in a blanket and tell them one answer that surprised you.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Praise only: for five minutes, tell your partner exactly what they're doing right. Be specific. Watch them glow.
cards.aftercare: Ask which compliment landed hardest, then say it once more, slowly.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Whisper an order across the room. Something small: come here, sit closer, take one thing off. They may say yes or no.
cards.aftercare: When they do it, thank them like it's the best gift you've had all week.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Make your partner earn permission to kiss you. Set the task: a compliment, a confession, a back rub. Then grant it generously.
cards.aftercare: Tell them what made you say yes, and give them one kiss for free.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: For 10 minutes, your partner gives every instruction. You may only answer 'yes' or the safeword.
cards.aftercare: Trade places for a slow hug and ask how it felt to hand over the wheel.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Service hour: one of you is cared for completely. Drinks brought, shoulders rubbed, clothes removed on request. They lift nothing.
cards.aftercare: Whoever served gets ten minutes of being held, no questions asked.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: No hands. Tease your partner using only your lips, your voice, and the brush of your hair against their skin.
cards.aftercare: Then use your hands for something gentle: stroke their hair until they melt.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Halfway through, switch who's in charge. Whoever led first now follows whatever the new boss decides.
cards.aftercare: Tell each other which half you liked better, and why.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Your partner sits, stands, or kneels exactly where you point. Keep them waiting for the next instruction. Make the pause delicious.
cards.aftercare: Bring them a glass of water and sit at eye level to check in.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Set one rule for tonight, like 'ask before you touch' or 'call me by a title.' Each slip earns a playful consequence you agreed on first.
cards.aftercare: Forgive every slip with a kiss and tell them they did beautifully.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Secretly signal: do you want a full power exchange tonight? One leads, one follows, safeword always honored. Only if everyone says yes.
cards.aftercare: Lie close for ten minutes after and trade one thing you loved about how the other led or followed.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Tell your partner to undress slowly while you stay fully clothed and watch. Narrate what you like. No touching until you say so.
cards.aftercare: Wrap them in your shirt or a soft blanket and tell them how gorgeous they looked.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Your partner may not finish, or even ask to, until you grant permission. You decide how long. They decide if it's too long.
cards.aftercare: Hold them close and tell them how proud you are of their patience.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Lead your partner to the bedroom by the hand. At every step, tell them in a low voice exactly what's about to happen.
cards.aftercare: Once it's over, tell them what you'll remember most and let them choose the cuddle position.

cards.label: Power
cards.text: Write three orders on scraps of paper, each bolder than the last. Your partner draws one at a time and may veto any with the safeword.
cards.aftercare: Read the unused orders aloud together and decide which to save for next time.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Blindfold your partner. Kiss them somewhere unexpected every 30 seconds. They guess where you'll land next.
cards.aftercare: Remove the blindfold slowly so the first thing they see is your smile.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Trace slow letters on their back with a feather. They have to guess the secret word you're spelling.
cards.aftercare: Whisper the real word and tell them why you picked it.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Warm drink in one hand, ice cube in the other. Alternate kisses: hot, cold, hot. They pick which wins.
cards.aftercare: Share the rest of the warm drink under one blanket.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Tie their wrists loosely with a soft scarf. Quick-release knot, scissors in reach, and check they can slip free. Then take your time.
cards.aftercare: Untie them gently, rub their wrists, and ask what felt best.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Touch everywhere except where they want it most, until they ask nicely. You get to define 'nicely.'
cards.aftercare: Give them exactly what they asked for, then hold them until they're calm again.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Scratch their back slowly, light to firm. They call out 'more' or 'less.' Keep it gentle enough that nothing lingers.
cards.aftercare: Smooth lotion along every path you scratched.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Negotiate a spanking first: where, how firm, how many. Count them out loud together. Stop the instant the safeword lands.
cards.aftercare: Rub the spot soothingly and tell them how much you trust them.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Blindfold on. Run five textures over their skin: silk, fur, something cool and metal, a soft brush, your lips. They rank them.
cards.aftercare: Let them do the same to you, then compare your top picks.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Drag an ice cube slowly down their spine. Chase every drop with a warm kiss.
cards.aftercare: Dry them off with a warm towel and keep them wrapped in it.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Secretly signal: soft ties tonight? Quick-release knots, scissors nearby, safeword ready. It only happens if everyone says yes.
cards.aftercare: Release them slowly, massage where the ties were, and tell them what their trust felt like.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Blindfold and soft ties together, quick release in reach. They can't see or reach you. Tell them everything you're about to do, then do it.
cards.aftercare: Unwrap them like a gift, then hold them until they're ready to talk.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Bring them right to the edge, then stop. Three times. On the fourth, they decide what happens.
cards.aftercare: Bring them water, brush their hair back, and tell them they were incredible.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Pin their wrists gently above their head with one hand. Explore with the other. Let go the instant they ask.
cards.aftercare: Kiss each wrist, then lace your fingers through theirs.

cards.label: Sensation
cards.text: Sensory overload: blindfold, slow music, ice in one of your hands, a feather in the other. Ask 'color?' every few minutes.
cards.aftercare: Take it all away one sense at a time, then finish with a long, quiet hug.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Strangers at a bar: each of you invents a name, a job, and one secret. Meet across the room and try to pick each other up.
cards.aftercare: Drop character with a real kiss and tell them your favorite line of theirs.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: One of you writes a very specific job title; the other writes three 'qualifications.' Hold the interview. Hire only if truly convinced.
cards.aftercare: Give them a glowing performance review: three things they did that you loved.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: The masseuse: agree on the menu beforehand. One books the deluxe treatment; the other decides, within the menu, what's included.
cards.aftercare: Swap roles for a five-minute shoulder rub with no agenda at all.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Consensual boss and new hire, both adults, both very into it. Write the office rules together first, then hold a 'performance review.'
cards.aftercare: Clock out together: comfy clothes, a snack, and a debrief.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Consensual royal and bodyguard. Decide together beforehand: who's sworn to protect whom, and which forbidden line gets crossed tonight?
cards.aftercare: Out of character, tell them one moment that felt truly romantic.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Write a scene on three index cards: beginning, middle, end. Swap cards and act out your partner's version.
cards.aftercare: Keep the cards, and tell them which line made you blush most.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Photographer and model. Each writes one pose the other may request. Run a shoot with no camera, only direction and praise.
cards.aftercare: Tell them one 'shot' you'll be replaying in your head all week.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Each of you writes a secret scene on a card. Swap and read silently. Signal yes or no. You play it only if everyone says yes.
cards.aftercare: Whatever the answer, thank them for trusting you with that card.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Rival spies, one consensual interrogation. Agree first on the secret, the limits, and the safeword. Extract the secret using only your mouth.
cards.aftercare: Confess your own secret was always 'I adore you,' then hold them close.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Room service: write a menu of very adult offerings together. One orders; the other delivers. The tip is negotiable.
cards.aftercare: Order a real snack together afterward and eat it in bed.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: Celebrity and superfan, both adults, both entirely willing. Decide beforehand how far the meet-and-greet goes. Then let it go there.
cards.aftercare: Remind them they're your favorite person, no costume required.

cards.label: Roleplay
cards.text: The genie: your partner writes three wishes beforehand, within limits you've agreed on. Grant them one at a time, fully in character.
cards.aftercare: Grant one bonus wish after: a cuddle of any length they choose.
